summary: Midway and Vector Unit arcade powerboat racing series, spanning the 1999 cabinet, home ports, an HD sequel, and a mobile spinoff.

entries.title: Hydro Thunder
entries.definitive_edition: Dreamcast version plus PlayStation/Nintendo 64 secondary features

emulation.notes: Use Flycast for the primary route; DuckStation for PlayStation career mode; N64 emulation for four-player sessions; MAME for arcade reference.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-resolution Dreamcast emulation plus secondary platform features

primary.why: Hydro Thunder launched in arcades and was ported to Dreamcast, Nintendo 64, PlayStation, and Windows. The Dreamcast version is sourced as having graphics more detailed and closer to the arcade version than the other console versions, while the PlayStation and Nintendo 64 ports have their own unique mode/features.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Dreamcast version in Flycast at high internal resolution; then use PlayStation and Nintendo 64 emulation only for their unique career and four-player features.

secondary.exclusive_content: Career mode not found in the other versions.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the PlayStation career mode after the Dreamcast main route.
secondary.why: The PlayStation port has a sourced unique mode but lower overall fidelity than Dreamcast.

secondary.exclusive_content: Up to four-player local multiplayer with the Nintendo 64 Expansion Pak.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the N64 version for four-player local multiplayer sessions.
secondary.why: The N64 port has a sourced multiplayer feature absent from the other home versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Midway Arcade Treasures routes are compilation reissues based on the Dreamcast port, not arcade-original remasters.

entries.title: Hydro Thunder Hurricane
entries.definitive_edition: Windows Store release with Tempest Pack

emulation.notes: No emulator is needed for the recommended route; Xbox backward compatibility is the best fallback if Windows access is unavailable.

primary.version: Windows Store release with Tempest Pack
primary.why: Hydro Thunder Hurricane released on Xbox 360 via Xbox Live Arcade and later Windows Store. The Windows route has the highest PC output ceiling, and the Tempest Pack adds sourced tracks that should be included for completeness.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Store version with the Tempest Pack if available; otherwise play the Xbox 360 version on Xbox hardware or Xbox One backward compatibility with the DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later remaster is sourced; Xbox One access is backward compatibility for the Xbox 360 release.

entries.title: Hydro Thunder Go

emulation.notes: Windows Phone preservation is the likely route because the platform and store are discontinued.

primary.why: Hydro Thunder Go is sourced as a Windows Phone arcade-style boat-racing spinoff with Race, Time Attack, and an unlockable expert track. It has only one sourced platform route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Windows Phone hardware or preserved Windows Phone software environments where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later port or remaster is sourced.
